resources.string: To protect you from identity fraud, this app checks your device\'s security (for example, whether it is rooted, an emulator, or running a cloned copy of the app), how the form is filled in (typing rhythm and pastes, never the text itself), motion sensors, and, if you allow it, your approximate location once. It does not read your SMS, call logs, contacts, photos or files. The results are used only to assess fraud risk for this application.
